description:
Problem: the gate's decision depends on trusted inputs read from develop: .github/oracle-reviewers.yml, .github/inert-paths.txt, .github/soundness-paths.txt, _project/scripts/oracle_gate.py, _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py, _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/, _project/scripts/inert_paths.py and _project/scripts/soundness_paths.py. A merge that changes them can change how an open pull request is classified, for example from exempt-only to soundness, but nothing re-evaluates open pull requests until the hourly sweep.

Outcome: a push to develop that touches those paths runs the sweep job.

Decision gates (stop and report if one fails):
1. The push trigger is limited to branches [develop] and to exactly the gate's trusted policy inputs. A test keeps that path list equal to the gate job's sparse-checkout list, excluding .github/workflows/oracle-gate.yml if that is cleaner, and the decision is recorded.
2. Push-triggered sweeps get their own concurrency group, so they never cancel or join a pull request's gate run.

Item guardrails: sweep logic is unchanged and the sweep gets no new permissions. Do not add push triggers for other branches.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Close out with make pr-preflight, make pr-open, oracle SHIP on the exact head, then make pr-arm. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001). Every behavior change gets a test that fails on the previous code.
